headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.44
summary: Xbox Friends arrives in the launcher: see who is online, manage friend requests and add players by gamertag. Indonesian translations now load correctly.

items.text: Add Xbox friends and see who is online, including who is playing Minecraft.
Accept, decline and cancel friend requests from a dedicated requests tab.
Search for players by gamertag and add them without leaving the launcher.
Load Indonesian translations by restoring the proper locale folder.
Keep the launcher's original Minecraft install check after syncing with upstream.
